en: Black‑and‑white image showing a uniformed ceremonial guard standing on duty beside a striped wooden sentry box in front of a large brick building with tall windows and an iron fence. The guard wears an ornate hussar-style uniform with a tall, decorated shako or busby-style hat and holds a curved saber pointed downward. The setting appears formal and official, suggesting a military or governmental building.
